title: Scientific study mission in Uganda
summary: In 2026, N'DA Nattè Jonas took part in a study and research mission in Uganda focused on biodigesters, biogas, and the circular economy.
body:
As part of strengthening his technical expertise, our founder and CEO, N'DA Nattè Jonas, took part in a scientific study and research mission in Uganda in 2026.

The mission focused on biodigesters, biogas production, biowaste valorization, and circular-economy value chains. It provided an opportunity to exchange knowledge with international experts and identify innovations that can be adapted to Benin and West Africa.

These lessons will feed into our practices in Parakou, Natitingou, and Malanville-Guéné, in service of ever more effective biowaste valorization for Beninese communities.
